rule.description: One class in src/ declares at least 14 member methods, owns at least 2 shared mutable state objects (static container fields, instance container fields, module-scope containers it operates, or imported map-like bindings it mutates), and its methods are incohesive — more method pairs share no instance field than share at least one (LCOM1 > 0). The class therefore centralizes responsibilities that change for different reasons and is the hub through which the rest of the pipeline reaches shared state.

checks.description: Detect a single class that combines SFC compilation's distinct responsibilities — descriptor parsing and caching, language-block selection, script compilation and caching, imported-type dependency bookkeeping, proxy-module code generation, CSS-modules emission, hot-reload emission and compiler error formatting — while owning the shared caches the rest of the pipeline reaches through it.
checks.detected_relation: one class -> all SFC-compilation responsibilities + module-wide shared caches reached by templateLoader, pluginWebpack4 and pluginWebpack5
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The class holds responsibilities that change for different reasons (parser behavior, webpack request routing, compiler APIs, HMR runtime shape, error reporting), so every concern edit lands in one place and every consumer couples to it; the defining property of a god class is exactly this routing of unrelated responsibilities and shared state through one owner.

matches.evidence: SFCLoader (src/index.ts:77) declares 24 member methods (17 instance including the constructor, 7 static), owns 4 static container fields serving as module-wide caches — descriptorCache, clientCache, serverCache and typeDepToSFCMap — and its 276 method pairs share no instance field in 203 cases versus 73 sharing cases (LCOM1 = 130). The class was formed by absorbing six formerly dedicated modules; the deleted owners covered block selection, CSS-modules code generation, hot-reload code generation, error formatting, descriptor caching and script resolution. templateLoader.ts (3 references), pluginWebpack4.ts (5) and pluginWebpack5.ts (5) reach the caches and static helpers through this class.

excluded.candidates: VueLoaderPlugin classes in src/pluginWebpack4.ts and src/pluginWebpack5.ts
excluded.reason: Both plugin classes are touched by the diff (imports rewired to the injected hub) but declare only their apply method plus a static string namespace constant and own no shared container state, so they satisfy no condition of the rule; they are coupling victims, not the god class.

excluded.candidates: src/templateLoader.ts, src/pitcher.ts, src/stylePostLoader.ts, src/styleInlineLoader.ts, src/util.ts and the remaining modules
excluded.reason: These modules contain no class declaration; the rule evaluates class declarations only, so the adapter-shaped loader functions and utilities there can never match.

excluded.candidates: A large incohesive class owning only one shared-state object
excluded.reason: The rule requires at least two shared mutable state objects, so a coordinator holding a single cache does not match; the injected class owns four, which is part of what distinguishes it from a legitimate facade.
